summary: Iter 118 (SA CoParents): tested (1) full account deletion with purge + shared-record scrub + compliance anonymisation, (2) Professional Sets Ticks via POST /api/integrations/court-keys + joint_alignment_cases auto-tick, (3) Requested Checklist PDF. Backend 9/9 pass. Frontend Court page auto-ticks, pro-notes, untick/retick, and PDF download all work; /delete-account page copy + full deletion flow (DELETE confirm -> toast -> redirect to / -> login returns 401) work.

issues: After the deletion toast + navigate('/'), the home page's components (foundation_statement, milestone_logs, biff_logs autosave hooks) immediately rehydrate localStorage with their default empty state, so Object.keys(localStorage) is not strictly 0 after redirect. The actual data IS cleared at the time of deletion (window.localStorage.clear() is called), and no PII survives, but the keys repopulate as empty fresh-session defaults. Low priority / cosmetic only — if the spec strictly requires localStorage to be empty on the home page, the autosave hooks should skip writes until a user signs in.

action_items: Optional / low priority: suppress home-page autosave hooks' first-write of empty defaults so localStorage stays strictly empty after /delete-account. Currently cleared then immediately rehydrated with empty-state keys (sacoparents_foundation_statement, sacoparents_milestone_logs, sacoparents_biff_logs).
critical_code_review_comments: account_purge.py: UID_FIELDS + EMAIL_FIELDS list is manual — long-term, consider a per-collection whitelist of owner fields; today's blanket scan plus SKIP list is pragmatic but any new collection added to the app that stores user_id under a different field name would silently leak. A unit test enumerating backend collections and asserting UID_FIELDS covers each would be cheap insurance.

account_purge._scrub_shared array_filter uses `{'p.user_id': uid}` which is correct for `arrayFilters=[{'p.user_id': uid}]`. Confirmed scrubs only the deleting parent's slot; co-parent slot untouched (verified).
integration_routes.CourtKeyUpsert: Literal[...] rejects unknown requested keys with 422 — good. The X-Integration-Key is constant-time compared via match_integration_key.
court_checklist._sync_professional_requests uses `applied` set so once a source is seen, re-syncs don't re-add removed ticks — verified end-to-end (untick after auto-tick sticks).
DeleteAccount.jsx: localStorage.clear() happens before navigate('/'), but the home page's autosave useEffects immediately write empty defaults back. Not a security/data issue, just a UX purity nit.
test_credentials: Throwaway users registered iter118_* / iter118fe_* / iter118ct_* / iter118d_* / iter118del_* — all deleted via DELETE /api/auth/account at end. Seeded parent1/parent2/journey6 untouched. INTEGRATION_SHARED_SECRET read from /app/backend/.env, never printed.
seed_data_creation: None left behind. Residue from in-flight interrupts (2 court keys, 1 joint case, 1 agreement, 3 users) cleaned up post-run via admin script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_iter118_account_purge.py cover: purge full-scan + shared-record anonymisation + compliance scrub + GridFS cleanup; court-keys 401/422/200 + auto-tick + 'applied once' semantics; joint-case auto-tick required-only and assessment_type fallback; checklist PDF ticks vs no-ticks + JSON card unchanged. Run with: `cd /app/backend && set -a && source .env && set +a && export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) && pytest tests/test_iter118_account_purge.py -v`. Only remaining nit is cosmetic localStorage repopulation after delete redirect.
